provenance.comparability_note: Checkpoint was trained on the legacy MIDD+SIDD manifest; all reported metrics use the exact 850-sample high-ISO-ablation validation manifest.

metrics.correction_alignment: cosine similarity(method-noisy, teacher-noisy), within the shadow mask; uses the same teacher-correction MSE eligibility floor
metrics.correction_capture: dot(method-noisy, teacher-noisy) / dot(teacher-noisy, teacher-noisy), within the shadow mask; reported only when mean((teacher-noisy)^2) >= 1e-06
metrics.shadow_mask: Rec.709 luma(noisy RGB) < 0.25 after border crop
metrics.teacher_gap_closed: 1 - MAE(method, teacher) / MAE(noisy, teacher), within the shadow mask; uses the same teacher-correction MSE eligibility floor

provenance.purpose: cross-manifest evaluation of legacy alpha_0p7 baseline on the exact high-ISO-ablation combined validation set

reference_semantics.nind: exposure-corrected lower-ISO reference; report separately and do not interpret as strict clean ground truth

shared_metric_source.purpose: reuse exact noisy/teacher metrics and shadow-mask identities from the controlled comparison
